# Bun: ciphers

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To configure ciphers in a Bun HTTPS server, set the ciphers property on the ServerOptions object when creating an HTTPS server. The ciphers property SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact property name and type. The ciphers value SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact cipher string format and allowed ciphers. The default ciphers SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact default cipher list. The ciphers property affects TLS connections and must be set before the server starts.

Search intents:
- Bun ciphers
- Bun HTTPS server ciphers
- Bun ServerOptions ciphers

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/bun-ciphers --json
